name: schedule-ledger
description: Recurring HBAR payments on the Hedera Schedule Service (HIP-1215) with a Rust mirror-node indexer that tracks every run, including failures.

steps.text: The Schedule Service is not available on local chains or Hedera forks, so deploy to Hedera testnet. Unit tests use a mock Schedule Service and run offline. The indexer is a Rust crate and needs cargo (https://rustup.rs).

steps.label: Generate or import a deployer account
Fund the account with testnet HBAR
Set CONTRACT_ADDRESS in packages/indexer/.env (copy .env.example), then start the indexer

steps.text: Then change the contract and the event decoder in packages/indexer/src/events.rs to fit your product.
